regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation with Memory/HBM & Storage as the lone durable leader (breadth 0.75, eligible, not crowded), while AI Infrastructure is the clear challenger roughly 0.46 score behind. The only validated edge on this market is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control (gate_helps true); momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, and the track record's modest 48.8% directional accuracy means I hold conviction low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watch AI Infrastructure (rank 2, score 2.132, breadth 0.875, eligible) for a confirmed leadership handoff: this retires only if its durability_bar stays met AND the rotation margin versus Memory/HBM closes to near zero while Memory's breadth drops below ~0.6.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The dominant leader with the highest score (2.59) and healthy breadth (0.75). It is eligible and not crowded (z 0.41), so the absolute-trend gate is not capping it. The rotation margin over the challenger (0.458) is wide enough that it still owns the narrative, though momentum rank itself predicts nothing — the lean is a trend-following expression of the gate being green on the current leader, judged qualitatively durable given cohesion.
theses.dissent: Hurst is tagged 'mixed' rather than clean 'trend', and val_state is 'diverging' — leadership may already be stalling despite the high score. With rank-IC ~0, the rank alone has no predictive content.

falsifier.text: SMH fails to hold above its 21-day average before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the cleanest crowding flag in the eligible set (crowding_z 1.91, crowded: true). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade or short. I express the caution as an avoidance lean rather than overweight, since the crowding flag plus 'trend' Hurst means it is extended but not to be fought.
evidence: crowded: true (z 1.91) — highest crowding_z among top themes
guardrails: crowding is a size-down caution only
theses.dissent: Breadth 1.0 and a clean 'trend' Hurst tag suggest genuine participation — an 'avoid' here may simply miss continuation in a strongly cohesive theme, and the guardrails explicitly warn against treating crowding as a timing signal.

falsifier.text: CIBR makes a new 20-day high and holds it for three consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Ineligible (eligible: false) with durability_bar 0.12 and breadth 0.125 — a textbook failed trend with 'mean-revert' Hurst. The absolute-trend gate, the one validated edge on this market, explicitly keeps it off. No reason to be overweight an ineligible, mean-reverting theme.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting themes can bounce hard off lows, and crowding is negative (z -0.04) so there is no extension risk. But on a gate-disciplined book, ineligible means no positive lean; an avoid is the conservative read.

falsifier.text: SIL closes above its 50-day average and stays above it for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
